Star Buds Baltimore is proud to be the first Star Buds location in Maryland! We are a recreational cannabis dispensary, come see us for all your marijuana needs. Our compassionate and knowledgeable staff is here to help you get exactly what you need at the best possible price.

​

Star Buds Baltimore Recreational Marijuana Dispensary is proud to serve cannabis consumers in Baltimore County to include the communities of Aberdeen, Abingdon, Arbutus, Baltimore, Bel Air, Bel Air North, Bel Air South, Belcamp, Brooklandville, Brooklyn, Brooklyn Park, Carney, Catonsville, Chase, Cockeysville, Columbia, Curtis Bay, Dundalk, Edgemere, Edgewood, Elkridge, Essex, Ferndale, Fork, Fort, Howard, Garrison, Glen Arm, Glen Burnie, Gwynn Oak, Halethorpe, Hanover, Hunt Valley, Hydes, Jessup, Joppa, Kingsville, Linthicum Heights, Lutherville Timonium, Middle River, Milford, Mill, Nottingham, Overlea, Owings Mills, Parkville, Pasadena, Perry Hall, Pikesville, Randallstown, Riderwood, Riviera Beach, Rosedale, Rossville, Russett, Severn, Sparrows Point, Stevenson, Towson, Upper Falls, White Marsh, Woodlawn and the surrounding areas.

Come Visit Our Marijuana Dispensary!

Here at Star Buds Baltimore, we pride ourselves on servicing high-quality cannabis at our clean, safe, and friendly medical dispensary. If you are looking for a one-of-a-kind experience and the best dispensary near you, we encourage you to come by and take your time viewing our premium marijuana products. Located at 5975 Belair Rd, Baltimore, MD 21206, we are just off Belair Rd and Powell Ave and just outside of Cedmont. Unlike many other dispensaries in the area, we strive to provide you with the best dispensary experience possible.

At Star Buds Medical Marijuana Dispensary in Baltimore, we have an assortment of high-quality cannabis, including flower, pre-rolls, vapes, and carts, concentrates, edibles, tinctures, topicals, CBD, accessories, and apparel. Whether you have questions about our products or are looking for something specific, our expert budtenders are available to help you choose the right cannabis product for your needs. Above all, we provide you with the best rewards program among other dispensaries in Baltimore County and an online ordering system that allows you to quickly choose your favorite cannabis products and pick them up in-store! Please stop by and experience why we are the premier medical marijuana dispensary in Baltimore!

Know Before You Go…

This is my first time visiting Star Buds. What should I bring with me?

All visitors must be at least 21 years of age and must provide a valid photo ID. We take cash and there is also an ATM inside our dispensary for your convenience.

Is your dispensary open late?

We understand that normal operating hours are not always convenient for our consumers with busy lifestyles, which is why our dispensary is open every day from 9:00 am to 9:00 pm.

Does Star Buds offer any discounts or ways to save on orders?

We run product specials seven days a week, and our loyalty rewards program offers even more savings. We are happy to provide our MED card holders and veterans with a discount upon request.
